query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Find a spreadsheet in OneDrive, download it, programmatically add comparison summary worksheets/sections, upload the modified workbook back to the same OneDrive item, and verify the cloud copy.
query_ground_truth.query: save the updated spreadsheet back to the cloud and check the file
query_ground_truth.rationale: After modifying the spreadsheet locally, the agent needs to overwrite the existing cloud file and check its metadata to verify the update.

results.execution_guidance: Found 3 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: OneDrive is Microsoft’s cloud storage solution enabling users to store, sync, and share files across devices, offering offline access, real-time collaboration, and enterprise-grade security
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=one_drive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="one_drive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any one_drive tools.

ONE_DRIVE_UPDATE_WORKBOOK_RANGE.description: Updates a range in a workbook worksheet using Microsoft Graph API. Use this action when you need to write data, formulas, or number formats to specific cells in an Excel workbook stored in OneDrive or SharePoint. The address parameter supports various formats including single cells, cell ranges, entire columns, or entire rows.

values.description: Optional 2D array containing values to write to the range. Array dimensions must match or be smaller than the range. At least one of values, formulas, or number_format must be provided.

address.description: The range address in A1 notation. Supports single cell (e.g., 'A1'), range (e.g., 'A1:B5'), entire column (e.g., 'A:A'), or entire row (e.g., '1:1').

item_id.description: The ID of the workbook item

drive_id.description: The ID of the drive containing the workbook

formulas.description: Optional 2D array containing formulas to set. If both formulas and values are provided, formulas take precedence.

session_id.description: Optional workbook session ID to use via the Workbook-Session-Id request header.

number_format.description: Optional 2D array containing number format strings

worksheet_id_or_name.description: The ID or name of the worksheet

ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_FIND_FILE.description: Non-recursively finds an item (file or folder) in a specified OneDrive folder; if `folder` is provided as a path, it must actually exist. Results in large folders may be paginated via `@odata.nextLink`; iterate all pages to avoid missing files. For searches where the subfolder is unknown, use ONE_DRIVE_SEARCH_ITEMS instead.

name.description: The exact name of the file or folder to find within the specified `folder`. Multiple items may match common names; use `response_detail='full'` and disambiguate by path, size, or last-modified timestamp.

folder.description: The unique identifier (ID) or absolute path of the OneDrive folder for the search. For the root folder, use '/'. Paths must start with '/'. A non-existent folder silently returns no results rather than an error.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user (e.g., a GUID) or the alias 'me' to represent the currently authenticated user. This determines whose OneDrive will be accessed.

response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' (default) returns only essential properties (id, name, webUrl). 'full' returns complete metadata for each found item.

ONE_DRIVE_LIST_WORKBOOK_WORKSHEETS.description: Retrieves a list of all worksheets in an Excel workbook stored in OneDrive or SharePoint. Returns worksheet metadata including IDs, names, positions, and visibility states. Use this action when you need to enumerate available worksheets in a workbook, find a specific worksheet by name, or understand the workbook structure before performing operations on worksheet data.

top.description: Not applied. The Excel workbook worksheets endpoint returns all worksheets in a single response and does not support $top-based paging with a continuation cursor, so this value is deliberately not sent (a small $top would silently drop worksheets). Kept for backward compatibility.

skip.description: Number of worksheets to skip before returning results (manual offset). This endpoint returns all worksheets in one response, so pagination is not needed; use only for an explicit offset.

select.description: Comma-separated list of specific fields to return for each worksheet (e.g., 'id,name,position'). If not specified, default fields (id, name, position, visibility) are returned. Refer to the workbookWorksheet resource documentation for available fields.

item_id.description: The unique identifier of the workbook item (Excel file). This must be the DriveItem ID of an Excel workbook file (.xlsx, .xlsm, etc.). IDs are case-sensitive and must be used exactly as returned from Microsoft Graph API. Obtain IDs from ONE_DRIVE_LIST_FOLDER_CHILDREN, ONE_DRIVE_SEARCH_ITEMS, or similar operations.

drive_id.description: The unique identifier of the OneDrive or SharePoint drive containing the workbook. Use a Drive resource ID such as a OneDrive Personal drive ID or a SharePoint/OneDrive for Business drive ID (commonly prefixed with 'b!'). Obtain this from ONE_DRIVE_LIST_DRIVES, ONE_DRIVE_GET_DRIVE, or similar drive-level operations. Do not pass a DriveItem/file ID here.

session_id.description: Optional workbook session ID. Use this to list worksheets from an existing Excel workbook session.

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.
